proposal: Only the per-CTA immutable position cache uses16bit unsigned elements; global u32metadata/ABI stay unchanged. Both existing host up_show shared reservations change16*m+4*nh to12*m+4*nh.
bound_proof: cards::NUM_COMBOS is1326. Spot::new_impl enumerates exactly0..NUM_COMBOS, so hands contain at most1326unique combos.

RiverTable::new filters/enumerates existing hands; sorted slot has m<=nh<=1326. GpuPlan::build emits each enumerated pos asu32 into its two distinct card lists;0<=pos<m. Thus every copied position is0..1325, exactly representable in unsignedshort.

Cache starts at4*(nh_o+2*m_o), aligned for16bit access; length2*m_o consumes4*m_o bytes. Float regions end before it, unchanged. New bound4*nh_o+12*m_o covers all actual slots because host uses per-player maximum m. Empty list performs no cache access.

Every float value, operation order, predicate, sorted/card traversal, barrier, zeroing store, scan and payout expression remains byte-identical. Only implicit narrowing store and promoted unsigned16load differ.
